variants.title: Otwarta wiata
variants.prompt:
TASK
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE new basic Viking STONEMASON WORKSHOP building for Open Northland, a complete independent redesign with the welcoming spirit of old Cultures and HQ remaster material clarity. Output one isolated building master sprite on genuine transparent RGBA background, no board, text, labels, people, border or ground island. Small contact shadow only, no checkerboard painted into pixels. Landscape 1536x1024 composition, entire building uncropped with generous margins.

REFERENCES (all references, not edit targets)
Image 1: J / Warm Remaster world-style board. Primary palette and matte material/readability reference; allow architectural exploration. Do not repeat any building from this board.
Image 2: independent grey geometry envelope. PRIMARY CAMERA and approximate scale reference, NOT mandatory roof design. Match its orthographic projection: elevation 28.5 degrees above horizon, azimuth 22.5 degrees from front normal, zero roll, verticals vertical. Front horizontal edges slope about 11 degrees on screen, receding edges about 49 degrees; do not use symmetric 45-degree isometric yaw. Same object occupancy and human door proportions.
Images 3 and 4: owned original Cultures basic and upgraded mason workshops, ONLY atmosphere and function readability. Invent a different structural layout, roof silhouette and prop arrangement; do not trace or reconstruct. Do not use the upgraded stone pillars in this basic tier.
Image 5: our current 88px civilian animation-facing sprites, scale/proportion/color compatibility ONLY. Do not draw people or imitate character pixelation.

STYLE
Warm grounded painterly stylization, convincing matte wood, straw and cool stone, selective detail, clear large material groups, soft neutral daylight from upper left. Nostalgic small settlement, modest handcrafted asymmetry. Avoid photorealism, plastic toy/mobile-game gloss, huge inflated roofs, noisy microtexture, excessive orange, fantasy ornament, glowing windows.
MATERIAL / FUNCTION
Basic workshop construction uses wood, wheat/straw and stone. Timber frame and straw roofing should dominate architecture; modest rubble/stone footings. Raw grey rocks -> cut masonry blocks, a waist-height stone working slab, a wooden mallet and chisels in readable groups. No forge, chimney, furnace, bakery goods, metal roofing or elaborate finished stone palace.
SCALE
Adult height is 1.78 design units. Clear storage-door opening 1.94 high by .95 wide (excluding timber frame), roughly 1.09 adult heights. Roof ridge about 3.15 high, overall working structure about 4.6 wide by 3.4 deep. Keep a clearly visible ordinary human-size storage door for later calibration. The target review is adult 88 screen pixels and door 96 at world zoom x2; these are display targets, not requested master pixel dimensions. Generate genuine high-resolution detail, do not upscale a low-res sprite.
DESIGN VARIANT
Low asymmetric thatched gable over a broad open work bay with a compact plank tool locker at the rear-left. Broad thin straw roof planes, exposed crooked timber braces, one large working stone under the right half, neatly grouped finished blocks front-left. Quiet warm remaster painting closest to J. Distinct from original by low roof, inset storage room and wide horizontal silhouette, no stacked roof or side lean-to.
